dict.string: TipTour_Hermes uses your microphone so you can talk to it.
TipTour_Hermes needs screen recording access to see what's on your screen and point at the right elements.

TipTour_Hermes uses Apple Events to control other apps on your behalf — opening URLs in Chrome and Safari, sending iMessages, organizing Finder, scripting Numbers/Pages/Keynote, and other agent-driven workflows. You'll be asked to allow each target app individually the first time TipTour_Hermes tries to drive it.
TipTour_Hermes uses System Events to script the macOS UI — typing keystrokes, clicking menu items, and reading window state — on behalf of your background agents.
TipTour_Hermes can use the camera when an agent needs visual context (e.g. when you point a webcam at a document for the agent to read).
TipTour_Hermes agents may save files to your Desktop when you ask them to create documents or download research.
TipTour_Hermes agents may read or write files in your Documents folder when you ask them to organize, create, or summarize documents.
TipTour_Hermes agents may read or save files in your Downloads folder when handling research artifacts.
TipTour_Hermes agents may access connected drives when you ask them to organize or copy files to or from external storage.
TipTour_Hermes agents may access network-mounted volumes when you ask them to work with shared drives or remote storage.
TipTour_Hermes agents may read your Contacts when you ask them to look up phone numbers, email addresses, or send messages to specific people.
TipTour_Hermes agents may read or create calendar events when you ask them to schedule meetings or summarize your day.
TipTour_Hermes agents may read or modify your full calendar when you ask them to schedule, reschedule, or analyze events.
TipTour_Hermes agents may read or create reminders when you ask them to add tasks or summarize your to-do lists.
TipTour_Hermes agents may read or modify all of your reminders when you ask them to organize, complete, or analyze your task lists.
TipTour_Hermes agents may browse your Photos when you ask them to find or describe images.
TipTour_Hermes agents may add images to your Photos library when you ask them to save generated or downloaded artwork.
TipTour_Hermes agents may read your Music library when you ask them to find tracks or build playlists.
TipTour_Hermes agents may use your approximate location when you ask them about local services, weather, or directions.
TipTour_Hermes agents may use your approximate location when you ask them about local services, weather, or directions.
TipTour_Hermes may use on-device speech recognition for fallback transcription when the cloud voice service is unavailable.
TipTour_Hermes may connect to local services on your network — for example, the Chrome DevTools Protocol on 127.0.0.1, or local MCP servers — when agents drive a local browser or developer tool.
TipTour_Hermes agents may interact with Bluetooth devices when you ask them to manage connections or read sensor data.
